Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join target_dictionary (chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1772927') to assays on tid, assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
